description.en: Specify the end time for the query.
Specifies whether to use a private bucket.

description.zh:
按给定字段排序，取值范围：
- Id（默认）
description.en:
The field to sort the records by. Valid value:

- Id (default)

description.zh:
排序方式。取值范围：
- asc（升序）（默认）
- desc（降序）
description.en:
The sorting method. Valid values:

- asc (ascending, default)

- desc (descending)

description.zh:
按存储记录类型查询。取值范围：
- record（录制）
- snapshot（截图）
description.en:
The type of the recording record to query. Valid values:

- record (Recording)

- snapshot

title.en: Query the list of recording records

descriptions.zh: > 截图查询目前不支持分页，仅支持按迭代方式。使用返回结果里的extStartTime参数值，作为新请求的StartTime可请求下一页。
descriptions.en: > Paging is not supported for snapshot queries. Only iteration is supported. To request the next page, use the NextStartTime value from the response as the StartTime for the new request.
